title: Global BGP route withdrawal — all services unreachable for 6h32m
description: Backbone router maintenance config change accidentally withdrew all BGP prefix announcements at 15:39Z. DNS unreachable globally. 0/24 BGP peers active. Remote remediation impossible — internal tools also unreachable. Physical datacenter access required. Routes restored manually at 22:12Z. Based on Facebook/Meta BGP withdrawal incident 2021-10-04 (engineering.fb.com/2021/10/05/networking-traffic/outage-details/).

title: Deploy out-of-band management network independent of BGP backbone
description: During the BGP withdrawal incident, engineers could not reach network equipment remotely. All SSH/VPN access routed through affected backbone. Requires dedicated OOB management plane on separate physical network. Also: implement BGP change freeze requiring 2-person approval.
